target_translation: sas_compat.classification_table(X, y, pd) on the 105,000 training rows of the final model (X = intercept + the 18 selected variables, y = default_flag, pd = the final pd). (1) BIAS-ADJUSTED (one-step leave-one-out) probabilities: w = pd(1-pd); V = inverse(X' diag(w) X); q_j = x_j' V x_j; leverage h_j = w_j q_j; eta_j = logit(pd_j); pstar_j = 1/(1 + exp(-(eta_j - (y_j - pd_j) q_j / (1 - h_j)))). (2) GRID: ProbLevel from floor(min pd / 0.02)*0.02 to ceil(max pd / 0.02)*0.02 by 0.02 (0.000..0.880, 45 rows; pd min 0.00084, max 0.86250; pstar max 0.86374 gives the same grid, so pd vs pstar for the grid ends is untested). (3) at each level z a row is classified as an event when pstar >= z (> gives identical counts: no pstar on a grid point). n1 = events, n0 = nonevents: CorrectEvents = events classified event; CorrectNonevents = nonevents classified nonevent; IncorrectEvents = NONEVENTS classified event; IncorrectNonevents = EVENTS classified nonevent; Correct = 100*(CE+CN)/N; Sensitivity = 100*CE/n1; Specificity = 100*CN/n0; FalsePositive = 100*IE/(CE+IE); FalseNegative = 100*IN/(CN+IN); PPV = 100*CE/(CE+IE); NPV = 100*CN/(CN+IN); a 0 denominator gives missing -> EMPTY field (0.000 row: FalseNegative, NPV; 0.880 row: FalsePositive, PPV). Columns in that order (ProbLevel first). Printed: ProbLevel 3 decimals ('0.020'), counts integers, percentages 1 decimal ('93.5'). The listing shows only Pos/Neg Pred, the ODS dataset also has FalsePositive/FalseNegative = 100 - PPV/NPV

source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC model option lackfit: ODS LackFitPartition
target_translation: sas_compat.hosmer_lemeshow(y, pd) -> partition frame. Inputs: the 105,000 training rows the fit used (none dropped: no missing model variable in model_features_train, batch-1 row 16), y = default_flag, p = the final model's pd (the pd_logistic written to risk_scores_train.csv). (1) sort by p ascending (stable). (2) BLOCKS: starting at the first unassigned row i, a block is every row with p <= p_i + 1e-6 (anchored at the block's SMALLEST pd, NOT chained between neighbours, NOT exact ties). NGroups = number of groups (10 here). (4) every row's pd is replaced by its BLOCK'S SMALLEST pd for the expected counts: EventsExpected = sum of that pd over the group, NoneventsExpected = Total - EventsExpected; EventsObserved = count(default_flag = 1), NoneventsObserved = Total - EventsObserved. source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC descending, selection=stepwise slentry=0.05 slstay=0.05
target_translation: sas_compat.stepwise_logistic over the 36 candidates in MODEL statement order (train.sas:51-80): (1) intercept-only start; after every step, test REMOVAL first, then ENTRY. (2) REMOVAL: Wald chi-square for each effect in the model; remove the one with the SMALLEST chi-square if its p > 0.05 (ties: first in MODEL order), one per step. (3) ENTRY: for each candidate not in the model, in MODEL order, skip it if it is aliased with the CURRENT model (relative residual V / (z'Wz) < 1e-8, where V is its residual variance after projecting on the model's columns in the information metric; decided per step, never by pre-excluding columns: on this data only flag_serious_delinquency, identical to has_serious_delinquency, is skipped, from step 5); else compute the score chi-square U^2/V at the current fit; enter the LARGEST chi-square (DF=1; strict >, so equal chi-squares go to the FIRST in MODEL order; never select by smallest p, which underflows) if its p < 0.05. (4) Stop when nothing enters or the best entry is the effect just removed. Newton to max|step| < 1e-10 at every step. source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC nofit + roc 'Training Set' pred=pd_logistic; ods output ROCAssociation=work.roc_train

With n1 events (default_flag=1, event='1'), n0 nonevents, P=n1*n0 pairs, N=n1+n0: an event/nonevent pair is concordant when pd_event > pd_nonevent, TIED when |pd_event - pd_nonevent| <= 1e-8 (same fuzz as RULEBOOK A8, an approximation of SAS's ROCEPS grouping; exact equality prints identically on every input), else discordant; Area = (C + T/2)/P (Mann-Whitney); StdErr = DeLong: V10_i = (#nonevents below event i + 0.5*#tied)/n0, V01_j = (#events above nonevent j + 0.5*#tied)/n1, StdErr = sqrt(var(V10, ddof=1)/n1 + var(V01, ddof=1)/n0); LowerArea/UpperArea = Area -/+ 1.959963985*StdErr (95% Wald); SomersD = (C-D)/P; Gamma = (C-D)/(C+D); TauA = (C-D)/(N(N-1)/2). O(N log N) via searchsorted on the sorted nonevent/event scores, never an N1 x N0 matrix. Keep full precision in memory (downstream uses Area).
